data.See what students say about the Amity Un: As per Himanshu Sharma, a student of B.Tech Electronics & Communication Engineering at Amity University. Amity University Jaipur offers a balanced and lively campus experience, though the placement scenario varies across courses. Placements typically start from the 4th or 5th semester for many courses, with an average package of around INR 3.5 lakh per annum and top packages reaching approximately INR 50 LPA. For students not securing placements, the university supports startups, fun anding entrepreneurial ventures. The curriculum follows a semester system with mid-term and end-term exams of moderate difficulty. Classrooms are modern, air-conditioned, and equipped with projectors, though some smaller classrooms lack such facilities and cameras.
